name: firetable-hostbot-tests
description: Tests for firetable-hostbot: the tag engine and play history toolkit, database rules and the bot itself in the Firebase emulators, and the auto-update script. Never installed on the bot server.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:history && npm run test:rules && npm run test:bot && npm run test:auto-update
scripts.test:rules: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only database,auth --project demo-ft "node test/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:bot: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only database,auth --project demo-ft "node test/bot.test.mjs"
